Package com.helix.api.ml

Record Class OnnxModelDescriptor

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.helix.api.ml.OnnxModelDescriptor
Record Components:
modelName - Unique model identifier (e.g., "fraud_model_v1")
version - Semantic version string (e.g., "1.0.0")
modelPath - Filesystem or volume storage path to the .onnx binary file
inputFeatures - Immutable ordered list of feature channel names expected by the model input tensor
outputTensorName - Output tensor identifier (e.g., "probabilities" or "action_logits")
outputIndex - Target output index to extract from the output tensor (e.g., 1 for fraud class probability)
description - Human-readable description or purpose of the model
fileSizeBytes - Size of the serialized .onnx artifact in bytes
active - Flag indicating if this version is currently active for rule evaluation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record OnnxModelDescriptor(String modelName, String version, String modelPath, List<String> inputFeatures, String outputTensorName, int outputIndex, String description, long fileSizeBytes, boolean active) extends Record implements Serializable
Metadata descriptor defining an ONNX machine-learning model artifact.

Encapsulates model identification, versioning, storage paths, input feature signatures, and output tensor mapping required for in-process JVM inference execution.
